name: Escritorio de encino con cajonera
adaptations: Solid oak is written in T18 plywood.
Finish: matte oil or wax look, closest id danish-oil.
Rounded top corners and rounded edge become square.
Fluted drawer fronts (two lower) become flat; recessed slot pulls become notch pulls not drawn.
Pedestal hangs from the top and rests on a rail in the original; here it is a standard pedestal.
Depth 650 estimated from the photos; height 750 assumed (no measure given).
splayed A-frame legs and stretchers drawn as straight legs with an apron on the side that has no pedestal
notes: Escritorio de 150 x 65 cm con cajonera de tres cajones a la derecha, colgada bajo la cubierta. Patas abiertas en ángulo con travesaños; en el original todo es encino macizo.
